comparison.objective: Load a vial into a vacuum desiccator, evacuate it, isolate it, and stop the pump.
comparison.physical_skill: Dome removal/reseating, vial placement, stopcock rotation, switch operation, and pressure monitoring.
comparison.success_condition: Vial upright on the ring, dome sealed, pressure at or below -90 kPa, stopcock shut, pump off, with venting no faster than 12 kPa/s.
comparison.reason: Tests vacuum-process sequencing and seal management, not adjustable damping.
